title: Grilled Fish with Stone Bowl
description: A simple and delicious Argentinian-inspired dish featuring grilled fish served with a stone bowl. The balanced flavors and perfectly cooked fish make this a great meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
2. Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
3. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
4. Grill the fish for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. While the fish is cooking, prepare the stone bowl by heating it in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 10 minutes.
6. Remove the bowl from the oven and add a squeeze of lemon juice.
7. Serve the grilled fish in the stone bowl and garnish with garlic.
